description: Set up, configure or troubleshoot Salesforce Collaborative Forecasts: forecast types, forecast categories, rollup methods, quota management, forecast hierarchy, manager adjustments, pipeline inspection integration. Trigger keywords: forecast type, forecast category, cumulative rollup, individual rollup, quota, forecast adjustment, forecast hierarchy, opportunity splits forecasting, pipeline forecast. NOT for configuring the opportunity stages, sales processes or split types themselves — use admin/opportunity-management. NOT for territory-based forecasting setup — use admin/enterprise-territory-management. NOT for Classic/Customizable Forecasting.
inputs: org edition (Enterprise, Performance, or Unlimited — required for Collaborative Forecasts)
number of distinct forecast motions in use (by revenue, product, overlay, territory)
whether quotas need to be loaded and displayed
name: collaborative-forecasts
official_sources: **Metadata API Developer Guide, `ForecastingSettings`** (grep -n "^ *ForecastingSettings *$" api_meta.txt, 2nd hit at line 117436) — `Forecasting.settings` file name and location (117448); "The maximum number of forecast types is four" (117503); the eight required `forecastingCategoryMappings` and their rollup/source enums (117520–117560 and 117969); `forecastedCategoryApiNames` as the rollup switch (117640, 117655) and `displayedCategoryApiNames` matching it (117615, 117617); `ForecastingDateType` enum (117659); the fixed forecast-type `name` list (117722); `AdjustmentsSettings` including "Disabling adjustments results in adjustment data being purged" (117828–117852); `ForecastRangeSettings` limits and `PeriodTypes` (117910, 117913); `QuotasSettings.showQuotas` (117948); and the declarative sample the metadata examples are shaped from (117984). Supports: Before Starting, Core Concepts, `references/metadata-examples.md` §1, Gotchas 1 and 9, and every enum in `scripts/check_collaborative_forecasts.py`.

**Metadata API Developer Guide, `ForecastingType` / `ForecastingSourceDefinition` / `ForecastingTypeSource` / `ForecastingFilter` / `ForecastingFilterCondition`** (api_meta.txt lines 74820–75500) — `roleType` `R`/`Y` (75264); `sourceObject`, `measureField`, `dateField`, `userField`, `categoryField`, `territory2Field` enums (75066–75129); `relationField` and the fixed parent chain (75413); "a forecast type can contain up to three filter conditions" (75041) and "Only AND is supported" (74848); and the two Usage rules that drive the release plan — "Deploy the zip file twice to create and activate the forecast type" and "Legacy forecast types that were available before API version 52.0 can be deactivated but not activated, created, or deleted" (75360–75364). Supports: `references/metadata-examples.md` §2 and §5, Gotcha 11, Recommended Workflow step 5.

**Metadata API Developer Guide, `CustomValue` / `StandardValueSet`** (api_meta.txt line 47578 for `forecastCategory`, 79289 for the `GlobalPicklistValue` repeat, 47611 for `won`, 130788 for the `OpportunityStage` sample) — the deployable stage forecast-category enum `Omitted` / `Pipeline` / `BestCase` / `Forecast` / `Closed`, and "When you deploy a StandardValueSet, this array must contain at least one picklist value." Supports: Gotcha 10, `references/metadata-examples.md` §3, and the stage check in the checker script.

**Object Reference, `ForecastingQuota`** (grep -n "^ *ForecastingQuota *$" object_reference.txt, 5th hit at line 147887) — the Managed Quotas permission and the "users can only edit their subordinates' … not their own" rule (147888); `StartDate` "can include any day in a given month. Stored using the first date of the month" (148027) — which is why Gotcha 5 was rewritten; `PeriodId` "Read only" (147978); `IsAmount` / `IsQuantity` with no Create property (147946, 147955). Supports: Core Concepts § Quotas, Gotcha 5, the quota CSV in `references/metadata-examples.md` §4 and the CSV lint in the checker.

**Object Reference, `ForecastingItem`** (line 147263) — `ForecastingItemCategory` giving the exact composition of every rollup column, including `BestCaseForecast` = Best Case + Most Likely + Commit + Closed (from 147384); "In organizations using cumulative forecast rollups, the `ForecastCategoryName` field can be null" (147423); and the access guidance "Users without the 'View All Forecasts' permission have access to all fields for their own subordinates and child territories" (147269–147271). Supports: the corrected cumulative-rollup table in SKILL.md, Gotchas 12 and 13, verification query 7.

**Object Reference, `ForecastingAdjustment` (145555), `ForecastingOwnerAdjustment` (147630), `ForecastingType` (148676)** — the manager-vs-owner distinction the two objects encode; `AdjustmentNote` "maximum length is 255 characters. This field doesn't appear in reports" (145600); the standard category list plus "You can add a Most Likely category and can customize forecast category names in single category rollups" (147671); `IsActive`, `IsPlatformType` (148811), `HasAdjustments` (148759), `DeveloperName` "is called `name` in the Metadata API" (148741). Supports: Core Concepts § Forecast Adjustments, the audit-mode SOQL, Gotchas 11 and 13.

**Object Reference, `User` (`ForecastEnabled`, line 295304), `UserRole` (`ForecastUserId`, line 303412), `Territory2` (`ForecastUserId`, 287371), `OpportunityStage` (195434), `Period` (216930)** — "Indicates whether the user is enabled for forecasts"; "The ID of the forecast manager associated with this role"; the two stage vocabularies `ForecastCategory` (195466) and `ForecastCategoryName` (195492); and `Period.IsForecastPeriod` (216985), which is the real object behind forecast period boundaries — there is no `ForecastingPeriod` object in the Object Reference. Supports: the forecast-hierarchy verification queries, Gotchas 5, 7, 8 and 10, and the user-CSV check.

**Pipeline Forecasting Implementation Guide (PDF)** — user enablement and Allow Forecasting, the Forecasts Hierarchy page's Enable Users / Assign Manager actions, and the View Roles and Role Hierarchy requirement quoted in Gotchas 7 and 8. Supports: Mode 1 Step 5, Mode 3, Gotchas 7 and 8.

**Salesforce Help — Set Up Collaborative Forecasts, Define Forecast Types, Forecast Categories, Cumulative Forecast Rollups, Forecast Hierarchy, Define Forecast Managers** — the Setup-side navigation and the rollup-switch adjustment-deletion claim now marked UNVERIFIED (2026-09-05) because neither developer guide states it. help.salesforce.com cannot be fetched in this environment, so these are carried as prior sourcing, not re-verified. Supports: Mode 1 and Mode 2 navigation steps, Gotcha 1's caveat.
**Salesforce Well-Architected** — the Operational Excellence / Reliability / Security framing used in the Relevant Pillars section above.

**Salesforce App Limits Cheat Sheet** — `grep -n -i "forecast" salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.txt` returns **zero hits**. No forecasting limit in this package rests on the cheat sheet. The four-forecast-type maximum is grounded in the Metadata API guide instead (api_meta 117503), and the "raise the limit through a Support case" route is recorded as UNVERIFIED.
**`ForecastingPeriod`** — not an object in the Object Reference. Earlier guidance to query it has been replaced with `Period WHERE IsForecastPeriod = TRUE`.

**Edition restriction** — no statement in either developer guide limits Collaborative Forecasts to Enterprise / Performance / Unlimited; `ForecastingType.DateType` lists Professional Edition for API 57.0+ custom-date types. Recorded as UNVERIFIED in SKILL.md rather than repeated.
